methodology.rule: Preserve each frozen feature ID while separating materially different native action owners, authority, Site, state, transaction, lock, and replay semantics.

source_packet_corrections: Separate the allocation-history read projection from suggested-match review, confirm, reject, and settlement replay/provenance dependencies.
Replace missing route and page claims with the exact allocation-history and payment-matching loci below.
PaymentSettlementRecorder and AccountsReceivableService are producer dependencies, not owners of the history-review action.

facets.authority: finance.ar.view or finance.ap.view; the controller partitions receivable and payable rows by the exact permission held.
facets.site_direct_object: Stored settlement Site scope filters rows. finance.payments.viewAllSites broadens read scope and admits legacy review-required rows. No direct allocation mutation route exists.
facets.state_effects: Read-only traceable-allocation versus legacy-review projection; the model blocks update and delete.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Not applicable to the read action.
collision_exclusions: Settlement and manual-AR producer commands are not review ownership.

facets.authority: List requires finance.bank.view; suggestion and match-all require finance.bank.manage.
facets.site_direct_object: List is organisation and stored-Site scoped; review does not re-prove that a stored proposal Site still equals its current target Site, while confirm and reject do.
facets.state_effects: Suggested, confirmed, auto-confirmed, or rejected; rejection evidence is immutable. Deterministic proposal keys suppress another non-rejected proposal and append a version after rejection.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Suggestion locks the bank transaction. Proposal versioning is not request idempotency.
contradictions: The view-only page renders auto-match and confirm or reject actions without a capability gate, although routes deny those commands to a finance.bank.view-only actor.

facets.authority: finance.bank.manage at the route envelope; the service does not independently re-check the action.
facets.site_direct_object: Organisation, stored proposal Site, current target Site, and actor target access are checked; inaccessible or mismatched targets are concealed as 404 unless manage-all-Sites applies.
facets.state_effects: Suggested to confirmed. AP and AR paths enforce sign, due, journal, allocation, and target-state rules; fully allocated invoices project paid state.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: One transaction locks journal sequence, match, bank transaction, then bill or invoice. An already-confirmed result replays only when canonical journal and allocation evidence remains present; no request key exists.
collision_exclusions: Evidence-conditioned state replay is not general payload-bound idempotency.

facets.site_direct_object: The same organisation, current-target, Site, and concealed-404 boundary as confirm.
facets.state_effects: Unsettled suggested to immutable rejected with actor, time, and reason; confirmed or rejected rows cannot be rejected again.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Proposal lock, validation, rejection evidence, and fail-closed audit share one transaction. Repeat reject fails; a later suggestion is a new version.

facets.authority: Producer commands retain their own exact AR, AP, or bank-management action; all-Sites permissions broaden scope but do not replace that action.
facets.site_direct_object: Canonical target and settlement Site are rechecked before append-only allocation evidence is accepted; inaccessible targets are concealed by the owning producer seam.
facets.state_effects: Settlement provenance binds allocation, target, source, journal, Site, actor, and bank-transaction evidence. These producer effects feed the history projection but are not owned by its read route.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Recorder uniqueness and producer locks prevent duplicate canonical settlement sources; replay strength varies by producer and is not one target-wide idempotency contract.
collision_exclusions: Producer integrity is a dependency of allocation history and must not be credited as the history-review action itself.

source_packet_corrections: Remove HrLifecycleAccessService as a primary owner of these profile facets.
The invite guard is User.approved_at null; the profile need not be inactive, correcting RUN-040.
HrEmployeeProfileVersion and HrEmployeeStatusChange have no production writer found at this pin; do not infer a version or status ledger.

facets.authority: hr.employees.viewAny plus hr.employees.manage; Clinical Lead and administrator-grade assignments have additional gates.
facets.site_direct_object: Every requested primary and secondary Site must be active, unarchived, and accessible, then revalidated and locked.
facets.state_effects: User, profile, roles, Sites, and fail-closed intake audit are atomic; link_existing can update or link an existing identity. Onboarding, compliance seed, invite, automation, and webhook are best effort after commit.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Normalized-email and employee-number mutexes exist. No request key; duplicate replay validates as duplicate, while an explicit repeated link can re-audit and re-emit.
collision_exclusions: This is create-or-link, not pure create.

facets.authority: hr.employees.viewAny; the policy self-view allowance is not reachable through these routes.
facets.site_direct_object: At least one historical or current assigned Site must overlap; wholly foreign or provenance-free profiles are concealed 404. viewAllSites broadens Site scope only.
facets.state_effects: Restricted, financial, document, leave, compliance, and related projections retain separate disclosure gates.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Not applicable to the read action.
contradictions: Policy self allowances are bypassed by route and controller gates.
collision_exclusions: Workers use the separate self-profile route.

facets.authority: viewAny plus manage; financial fields additionally require hr.employees.viewFinancial.
facets.site_direct_object: Edit permits any assigned-Site overlap, while mutation requires every assigned Site. A mixed visible and foreign profile can render edit but conceal PUT as 404.
facets.state_effects: Profile, destination Sites, and manager are locked; role, Site, and employment changes may create an IT mover workflow.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: No request key, entity version, or stale-write precondition; locks serialize but opposing writes remain last-writer-wins.
contradictions: The FormRequest lacks the HR global Site-bypass list used by the locked controller check, so global-HR foreign-Site update is not positively established.
PUT accepts is_active but does not apply the dedicated set-active login restoration, creating a second status-transition path.

facets.authority: viewAny plus manage, with access to every assigned Site; inaccessible targets are concealed before payload validation.
facets.site_direct_object: All assigned Sites are checked through the mutation seam.
facets.state_effects: Activation restores missing User approval. Deactivation does not revoke login, set end date, or write a status journal. The observer flags held assets and sends deduplicated alerts synchronously inside the transaction.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Target and actor graph are locked. Same-value repeats converge, but there is no request key or version; opposing commands are last-writer-wins.
contradictions: The generic update path can also change is_active without these effects.

facets.authority: viewAny plus manage and exact role-assignment gates.
facets.site_direct_object: Every old assigned Site must be accessible before rehire; the new primary Site must also be accessible.
facets.state_effects: The locked transaction cancels open offboarding, appends prior-stint history, restores soft delete, activates, clears termination fields, restores login, and synchronizes roles. Login audit, onboarding, invite, and webhook are best effort after commit.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: A repeat fails once active; it is not same-result replay and has no request key.
collision_exclusions: No executed outer-commit or concurrent-rehire proof is awarded.

facets.authority: viewAny plus manage, non-archived profile, and access to every assigned Site.
facets.site_direct_object: All assigned Sites are rechecked under the profile lock.
facets.state_effects: Guard is User.approved_at null; profile inactivity is not required. After commit, a token is created and the branded invite is queued.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: The transaction records no replay marker. Because send does not change approved_at, repeated requests can replace tokens and send multiple notifications.
contradictions: RUN-040's statement that resend requires an inactive profile is false at this pin.
collision_exclusions: Create and rehire use a different reset-link delivery implementation.

facets.authority: No production write command or exact action capability was found for either history model at this pin.
facets.site_direct_object: Not established because no production writer or direct-object workflow was found.
facets.state_effects: Profile-version and status-change schemas and relationships exist, but no production writer was found. Rehire employment_history JSON and generic audit logs are distinct evidence and cannot substitute for these ledgers.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Not established; model and table presence is not a transaction or replay contract.
contradictions: RUN-040's longitudinal-history implication is not supported by a production writer.
collision_exclusions: Do not credit rehire JSON employment history or generic audit logs as the missing version and status ledgers.

source_packet_corrections: Separate view, register movement, balance check, discrepancy resolution, destruction projection, and witness authority.
The controlled-drug policy defines controlled capabilities, but the controller routes use medications.orders.manage and do not invoke that policy.
Destruction write ownership remains CAP-MED-DESTRUCTION and is only an external projection dependency here.

facets.site_direct_object: Uses medication-viewable Client IDs, assignments, and broad medication or Client permissions rather than UserSiteAccessService. Supplied site_id is a Client query filter without explicit Site-authority validation.
facets.state_effects: Projects controlled medications, balances, entries, open or under-review discrepancies, destructions, and loss reports.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Not applicable to the read action.
contradictions: No bounded foreign-Site negative is established.

facets.authority: medications.orders.manage at the route; witness permission is checked separately.
facets.site_direct_object: Client and medication are found, but actor Site and direct-object access are not checked.
facets.state_effects: Validates caller-supplied before and after arithmetic, creates an entry, changes stock, then updates schedule.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Writes are not transaction-bound and take no stock or register lock. The optional seven-day cache key is not actor or payload bound, is checked before access, and is written after effects without an atomic mutex.
contradictions: ClientControlledDrugEntryPolicy defines medications.controlled.view and record, but this path does not invoke it.
collision_exclusions: The cache is not durable idempotency.

facets.authority: medications.orders.manage plus witness permission; actor Site checks are absent.
facets.site_direct_object: Same missing actor-Site seam as register movement.
facets.state_effects: Records check and stock; mismatch requires immediate-action evidence and creates a discrepancy plus linked incident and alerts.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Core writes are transactional but stock is not locked. Alert clearing occurs after commit. The optional cache has the same non-durable limitations as movement.
contradictions: A concurrent stock writer can race the unlocked balance transaction.

facets.site_direct_object: Direct route binding has no actor Site or current-Client access check.
facets.state_effects: Overwrites status and resolution evidence without an open-state precondition; alert and signal resolution is a separate call.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: No row lock, transaction, request key, or same-result replay.
contradictions: A failure after discrepancy save can leave closed discrepancy evidence with live alerts.

facets.authority: Projection requires medications.view; external destruction write requires medications.orders.manage.
facets.site_direct_object: Independent Client, medication, and Site identifiers are existence-validated but not ownership-consistency or Site-authority checked.
facets.state_effects: Creation is transactional and locks stock only when linked stock exists. The controlled page projects destruction evidence but omits void metadata.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: No request key. Void does not reverse stock or register movement.
contradictions: Controlled destruction can be saved without a controlled-register disposal entry when linkage or stock is absent.
Voided evidence can appear in the controlled page without its void state.
collision_exclusions: The destruction command belongs to CAP-MED-DESTRUCTION, not this target.

facets.authority: Movement and balance routes require medications.orders.manage; the selected witness is separately checked for medications.controlled.witness. The controlled-entry policy's record action is not invoked by these routes.
facets.site_direct_object: No witness Site overlap, Client assignment, current competency, or canonical relationship to the controlled record is established.
facets.state_effects: Witness identity is stored with movement and balance evidence, but the cross-cutting eligibility decision is not a separately governed command or snapshot.
facets.transaction_locking_replay: Witness authority inherits each caller's transaction and replay weakness; it has no durable eligibility snapshot or request key of its own.
contradictions: A named controlled-drug policy exists but the route/controller authority seam bypasses its record capability.
collision_exclusions: Witness identity presence is not proof of Site, assignment, competency, independence, or continuing eligibility.
